title: The Process Bottleneck Hunt
subtitle: Order fulfilment fell from 4 days to 11. Where is the time going?
learning_objectives: Use AI to decompose end-to-end process time into stage-level contributions
Detect hidden wait states and handoff delays in operational data
Distinguish systemic bottlenecks from one-off exceptions
Quantify the cost of delay and prioritise fixes by impact
deliverable: Bottleneck analysis with root-cause map and prioritised fix list
